title: P1-F0 F0-B send/flush fanout medium calibration

phases.label: Dispatch a synthetic DOM pointerup/click and observe the medium send/flush/fanout model
Keep the page foreground-active after the medium fanout action completes

sop: F0-B is not product trace replay.
F0-B uses structural fanout variables only.
F0-B requires one smoke first; no 3x run is allowed until separately approved.
Load the P1-F0 target and confirm visible audit state shows config_valid=true and capture_allowed=true.
Confirm scenario_mode=p1-f0-send-flush-fanout, calibration_level=medium, payload_shape=medium-json, content_richness=medium, and synthetic_pressure_multiplier=1.
Confirm stable_keys=true, react_memo_enabled=true, deferred_rendering=false, and token_coalescing=false.
Press Enter only after the page is loaded and the Chrome window is foreground-active.
Do not interact with the page during capture; the target dispatches synthetic DOM pointerup/click events on the visible send button when it observes p0:capture:start.
Keep the Chrome window foreground-active for the full 12 second capture window.
